question: At fixed truth-ω, does multi-axis Sobol-Shoemake(q0) on SO(3) + LM polish yield at least one in-basin landing per seed at low density (N=64)?
hypothesis: Uniform Sobol(q0) on SO(3) at N=64 + LM polish recovers truth basin on most seeds, because LM's grab radius exceeds the basin radius.
narrative_md: Multi-axis Sobol-Shoemake(q0) on SO(3) + LM polish at fixed truth-ω, 10 seeds x 64 ICs = 640 runs (39 min). 9/10 seeds get ≥1 in-basin landing at N=64. Key surprise: LM's grab radius (~50-100°) far exceeds the basin itself — even seed 28 (sub-Sobol basin) gets 7/64 hits. Failure: seed 10 (slowest tumbler, 1.06 rot) gets 0/64 — many low-MSE competing attractors, none near truth. Q4c works at low density; the cohort tail under-counted by s009's body-X probe.
